content.value_statement: Construction billing requires consistent progress totals, retainage calculations, and jurisdiction-specific documents. This guide helps AI assistants draft billing structures and identify review requirements.
actual_capabilities: Provides guidance for drafting G702-style summaries and G703-style schedules of values.
Describes retainage calculations for completed work and stored materials.
Includes a worked payment example using contract value, completed work, retainage, and previous certificates.
Outlines conditional and unconditional lien waiver selection, with references to California, Texas, and Florida requirements.
Describes WH-347 certified payroll drafts and Statement of Compliance requirements.
limitations: Only a Markdown guide is included; scripts, extension source, and original package templates are absent.
No executable calculation engine or tests substantiate the claimed automatic reconciliation guarantees.
Official AIA forms are not supplied and require separate licensing.
Generated legal and payroll drafts require current jurisdictional checks and qualified review; the guide does not provide legal advice.

use_cases.title: Prepare Monthly Progress Billing
use_cases.description: Draft a payment summary and schedule of values from approved project totals, then review retainage and previous certificates.

use_cases.title: Review Lien Waiver Requirements
use_cases.description: Compare conditional and unconditional waiver options for a project state before obtaining legal review.

use_cases.title: Outline Certified Payroll
use_cases.description: Organize a WH-347-style draft and identify missing payroll information and compliance review items.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Payment Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a G702-style summary: contract $150,000; no change orders; completed work $45,000; retainage 10%; previous certificates $25,000; no stored materials. Show calculations and assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: prepare a simple progress billing draft.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Schedule of Values
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this schedule of values: [rows]. Use completed-work retainage [rate] and stored-material retainage [rate]. Reconcile totals against previous certificates [amount] and flag missing inputs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: check billing totals across line items.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Lien Waiver Options
prompt_templates.prompt: For [state], compare waiver options for [progress or final payment] with payment status [status]. Identify current statutory sources requiring verification. Do not invent statutory text.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare waiver questions for legal review.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Federal Payroll Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a WH-347-style draft from [redacted payroll data] for [project and week]. Identify missing wage determinations, classifications, fringe details, and compliance statements. Flag unverified requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: organize payroll information for compliance review.

output_examples.input: Draft a payment summary for a $150,000 contract with $45,000 completed, 10% retainage, and $25,000 previously certified.
output: Assumptions: no change orders or stored materials; previous certificates total $25,000.

output_examples.input: Prepare a WH-347-style payroll outline for a new federal project without employee payroll records.
output: Draft status: incomplete; payroll records were not supplied.
Collect the project identifier, payroll week, worker classifications, hours, pay rates, deductions, and fringe benefit details.
Verify the applicable wage determination before evaluating wages.
Prepare the Statement of Compliance for authorized review and signature; do not certify unverified information.

best_practices: Supply approved change orders, billing dates, prior certificates, and separate retainage rates before drafting.
Independently verify arithmetic and reconcile schedule totals against the payment summary before submission.
Use redacted payroll data and obtain current legal or compliance review for waivers and certified payroll.
anti_patterns: Treating guide-generated calculations as guaranteed accurate without independent reconciliation.
Submitting generated text as an official licensed AIA form.
Signing unconditional waivers or payroll certifications without verifying payment status and supporting records.

faq.question: Does this package include billing software?
faq.answer: No. The supplied package contains one Markdown guide, not executable billing scripts, extension source, or original templates.

faq.question: Does it provide official G702 and G703 forms?
faq.answer: No. It describes AIA-style structures. Obtain separately licensed official documents when required for submission.

faq.question: Are retainage calculations guaranteed accurate?
faq.answer: No executable validation is included. Independently check calculations, rounding, and reconciliation against project records.

faq.question: Can it determine the correct lien waiver?
faq.answer: The guide discusses waiver selection and references California, Texas, and Florida. Verify current statutes and obtain qualified review before signing.

faq.question: Does it certify Davis-Bacon compliance?
faq.answer: No. It outlines WH-347 drafts and compliance statements. Authorized reviewers must verify wages, classifications, fringe benefits, and supporting records.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this guide?
faq.answer: Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can use the text as drafting guidance. Available integrations depend on the host assistant.
